name: filter-bar
title: Filter Bar
description: Universal active filter chips toolbar with badges, individual remove buttons, total count, and clear-all action.

files.content:
import * as React from "react" import { X } from "lucide-react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" export interface ActiveFilter { id: string label: string value: string displayValue?: string } export interface FilterBarProps { filters: ActiveFilter[] onRemove: (filterId: string) => void onClearAll: () => void className?: string } export function FilterBar({ filters, onRemove, onClearAll, className, }: FilterBarProps) { if (filters.length === 0) return null return (
Active filters ({filters.length}):
{filters.map((filter) => ( {filter.label}: {filter.displayValue ?? filter.value} ))}
) }
